description: This file defines the 'Marketing' controller class for the OpenCart admin reporting extension, handling report display, data retrieval, and saving configurations related to marketing reports.

classes.name: Marketing
classes.description: Controller class for managing marketing reports in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the marketing report form page with breadcrumbs and configuration data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of marketing report settings, with permission check and JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the marketing report list with order statuses.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves and renders the marketing report data with filtering, pagination, and view rendering.
